objects.name: fitness_parent_immutable
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fitness_parent_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF fitness_space_id ON fitness_entities WHEN NEW.fitness_space_id != OLD.fitness_space_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'FITNESS_PARENT_IMMUTABLE'); END

objects.name: fitness_parent_scope_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fitness_parent_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON fitness_entities WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fitness_spaces b WHERE b.id=NEW.fitness_space_id AND b.storage_mode=NEW.storage_mode AND b.scope_account_id IS NEW.scope_account_id AND (NEW.sync_id IS NULL OR b.sync_id IS NEW.sync_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'FITNESS_PARENT_SCOPE'); END

objects.name: fitness_parent_scope_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fitness_parent_scope_update BEFORE UPDATE ON fitness_entities WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fitness_spaces b WHERE b.id=NEW.fitness_space_id AND b.storage_mode=NEW.storage_mode AND b.scope_account_id IS NEW.scope_account_id AND (NEW.sync_id IS NULL OR b.sync_id IS NEW.sync_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'FITNESS_PARENT_SCOPE'); END

objects.name: memo_book_type_immutable
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memo_book_type_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF type ON memo_books WHEN NEW.type != OLD.type BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'MEMO_TYPE_IMMUTABLE'); END

objects.name: memo_entry_parent_immutable
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memo_entry_parent_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF memo_book_id,book_type ON memo_entries WHEN NEW.memo_book_id != OLD.memo_book_id OR NEW.book_type != OLD.book_type BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'MEMO_PARENT_IMMUTABLE'); END
